en.headline: Law Society urges ‘law comes first’ in five-year plan submission
en.dek: The professional body submitted recommendations stressing that economic and social development must rest on a clear, predictable and internationally credible legal framework, and offered proposals on the Northern…
body: The Law Society of Hong Kong has submitted its recommendations on the city’s first five-year plan, emphasising that all economic and social development visions must be implemented under the principle of “law comes first”. In its Thursday submission, the society said a clear, predictable and internationally credible legal framework is essential for attracting investment and driving innovation.

On land and infrastructure, the society supported rapid development of the Northern Metropolis but cautioned that streamlining procedures under the Northern Metropolis Development Bill must not come at the expense of procedural justice, environmental protection or public participation. It also recommended promoting Hong Kong as an international arbitration centre, establishing expert rosters for digital assets and ESG, and piloting sector-specific mediation schemes.

The submission further proposed establishing a dedicated Hong Kong Sports Law Office to coordinate legal support for sports governance, sponsorship and dispute resolution, and treating intellectual property as core economic infrastructure through measures such as an IP financing sandbox while monitoring legal challenges arising from artificial intelligence and deepfakes.

zh.headline: 律師會就五年規劃提交建議 強調「法律先行」
zh.dek: 律師會在意見書中強調經濟與社會發展願景須以清晰、可預測及具國際公信力的法律框架為基礎，並就北部都會區、仲裁及體育法等提出建議。
body: 香港律師會周四就本港首份五年規劃提交意見書，強調各項經濟與社會發展願景必須以「法律先行」為落實原則。會方指出，清晰、可預測且具國際公信力的法律框架是吸引投資和推動創新的核心條件。
在土地及基建方面，律師會支持全速發展北部都會區，但提醒在引入《北部都會區發展條例草案》等精簡程序時，不能以犧牲程序公義、環境保護或公眾參與為代價。會方亦建議繼續推廣香港作為國際仲裁中心，為數碼資產及ESG等新興領域設立仲裁專家名冊，並把握國際調解院總部落戶香港的契機，試行行業專屬調解計劃。
意見書亦建議政府牽頭成立「香港體育法辦公室」，統籌體育管治、贊助及爭議解決等法律支援，同時將知識產權視為核心經濟基建，推動知識產權融資沙盒，並密切注視人工智能及深度偽造技術帶來的法律與版權挑戰。
